Getnet Demil AI & Remote Sensing
  • About

Doctoral Researcher · AI & Remote Sensing for Hydrology

Getnet Demil
Jenberia

CMVS / ITEE, University of Oulu, Oulu, Finland

Deep Learning Remote Sensing Snow Hydrology Computer Vision Earth Observation GeoAI
Google Scholar GitHub LinkedIn University Profile

About Me

Doctoral researcher bridging artificial intelligence and Earth observation for climate-critical hydrology challenges.

20 Citations
5 Publications
4 Years Research
6 Projects

I am a doctoral researcher at the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering (ITEE), University of Oulu, specialising in artificial intelligence and remote sensing for hydrology modelling. My work focuses on developing deep learning methods that extract snow and water characteristics from multi-modal satellite imagery — combining Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical, and DEM data to build climate-resilient runoff prediction models.

My academic journey spans multiple continents: a BSc and MSc in electrical engineering and communication systems from Bahir Dar University, Ethiopia, followed by an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree (IPCV) across the University of Bordeaux (France), Autonomous University of Madrid (Spain), and Pázmány Péter Catholic University (Hungary). I am currently co-organising the HydroImaging Workshop at IEEE ICIP 2026 in Tampere, Finland — a testament to my commitment to the growing GeoAI community.

Beyond academia, I have worked as a Junior Electrical Engineer at the Ethiopian Electric Utility and Chief Technology Support at the American Space Ethiopia (U.S. Embassy), grounding my research in real-world engineering challenges and cross-cultural collaboration.

Earth Observation & GeoAI

AI-driven snow & water estimation from Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical satellite data for climate-resilient hydrology.

Erasmus Mundus Scholar

EU-funded EMJMD scholarship in Image Processing & Computer Vision, studying at three top European universities across France, Spain, and Hungary.

IEEE ICIP 2026 Organiser

Co-organising the HydroImaging Workshop on mining imaging data for hydrological and environmental modelling at IEEE ICIP, Tampere, Finland.

International Experience

Studied and worked across Ethiopia, France, Spain, Hungary, and Finland — bringing a truly global perspective to AI research and engineering practice.

Latest News

Recent conference presentations, publications, and research milestones.

Nov 2025

2025
Presentation

CrossFuse Research Presented at Digital Waters Flagship

Presented CrossFuse — a hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture for Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical data fusion for snow cover estimation — at the Digital Waters Flagship Biannual Meeting, Aalto University, Espoo, Finland.

Aug 2025
Conference

Paper Presented at DIGeMERGE 2025

Presented research on a machine learning approach for emergency communication ecosystems at the Digital Emergency Communication (DIGeMERGE) 2025 Conference, focusing on AI-enhanced citizen participation in Nordic countries.

Jun 2025
Conference

Attended CVPR 2025 in Nashville, Tennessee

Participated in the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR 2025), Nashville, TN, USA — the flagship venue for computer vision and deep learning research.

2025 In Press
Publication

Journal Paper Accepted in Earth Science Informatics

"Seeing through the clouds: enhanced snow and cloud segmentation in Sentinel-2 imagery with mDeepLabV3+" accepted in Earth Science Informatics (Springer). DOI: 10.1007/s12145-025-01950-6

2025
Publication

Systematic Review Published in Journal of Hydrology

"Advances in image-based estimation of snow variables" published in Journal of Hydrology (Elsevier). A comprehensive review of deep learning architectures for snow hydrology modelling. DOI: 10.1016/j.jhydrol.2025.132855

Oct 2024
Workshop

HydroImaging Workshop Accepted at IEEE ICIP 2026

Co-organised the HydroImaging workshop — "Mining Imaging Data for Hydrological and Environmental Modelling" — accepted at IEEE ICIP 2026, Tampere, Finland (September 13–17, 2026).

Research

Applying AI and multi-modal satellite data to advance our understanding of the cryosphere and water cycle.

Multi-Modal Satellite Data Fusion

Developing CrossFuse — a hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture that fuses Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical imagery to produce high-resolution snow cover and water equivalent estimates, supporting runoff prediction and flood risk assessment.

Sentinel-1 SAR Sentinel-2 CNN-Transformer Snow Hydrology

Deep Learning for Snow Segmentation

Designing mDeepLabV3+ — a modified DeepLabV3+ with ResNet backbone that separates snow from clouds in satellite imagery with state-of-the-art accuracy, enabling reliable year-round snow monitoring critical for water resource management.

DeepLabV3+ ResNet Semantic Segmentation Cloud Detection

AI for Climate & Emergency Response

Leveraging NLP and social media analytics for real-time local climate impact monitoring, and building AI-enhanced early warning systems that improve emergency communication ecosystems in Nordic countries.

NLP Social Media Analytics Early Warning Systems Climate AI

Research Interests

GeoAI & Earth Observation

Foundation models and vision transformers applied to large-scale satellite imagery for environmental monitoring.

Multi-Modal Data Fusion

Combining SAR, optical, DEM, and reanalysis data streams for richer environmental scene understanding.

Foundation Models for EO

Adapting large pre-trained vision models to geoscience tasks such as change detection and hydrological parameter retrieval.

Climate-Focused AI

Building data-driven tools that support climate adaptation — snow water equivalent estimation, flood mapping, and vegetation monitoring.

Projects

Selected research and engineering projects — from satellite image analysis to assistive robotics and climate AI.

CrossFuse Active

Hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture for fusing Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical satellite data to estimate high-resolution snow cover extent and snow water equivalent. The model integrates spectral band optimisation, attention mechanisms, and transfer learning to achieve superior performance on high-latitude, snow-dominated landscapes.

PyTorch Google Earth Engine Sentinel-1 SAR Sentinel-2 Transformers Python
GitHub
mDeepLabV3+ Published

Modified DeepLabV3+ architecture with ResNet-50/101 backbone for snow-cloud segmentation in Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery. Introduces dilated convolutions, optimised spectral band selection, and domain-adapted training to reliably separate snow cover from cloud cover — a persistent challenge in remote sensing.

TensorFlow OpenCV

OpenCV ResNet DeepLabV3+ Sentinel-2 Python
Paper (ESI)
Climate Social Media Monitor Published

Real-time NLP pipeline that mines social media streams to detect and monitor local climate impact events. Integrates transformer-based text classifiers with geo-tagged post analysis to identify floods, droughts, and extreme weather episodes as they unfold — bridging citizen science and AI for climate resilience.

NLP Transformers Social Media APIs Python SIGIR 2024

HydroImaging Workshop @ ICIP 2026 Upcoming

Co-organising the first HydroImaging Workshop — "Mining Imaging Data for Hydrological and Environmental Modelling" — at IEEE ICIP 2026, Tampere, Finland (Sep 13–17, 2026). The workshop brings together Earth observation, computer vision, and environmental modelling researchers. Featuring keynotes, oral sessions, and poster presentations.

Smart Microscope for Disease Diagnosis Best Africa Project

Computer vision system for automated protozoan disease detection using a custom-built microscopy platform. Achieved real-time classification of blood-borne pathogens, reducing diagnostic time in resource-limited clinical settings. Recognised as the Best Project at Bahir Dar University (2018) and one of the Best 50 African Projects of the Year at Africa Innovation Week (2019).

Vision-Aided Assistive Robotics Published

European consortium research project developing 6D pose estimation for individuals with upper-limb disabilities. Implemented DenseFusion model (joint point cloud + RGB processing) for accurate object pose recognition in unstructured environments, enabling robotic arms to grasp everyday objects reliably for users who cannot perform the task themselves.
